podcast.body: The first track on Side One of the 1980 album *Permanent Waves*. This song was directly inspired by Toronto's CFNY FM radio station, which at the time operated from a "little yellow house in Brampton, Ontario" and used "The Spirit of Radio" as its slogan. A note in the lyric sheet explicitly stated, "inspired by The Spirit of Radio in Toronto, alive and well so far." "Inspired by CFNY FM, now called one on two point one, the edge in Toronto, when it was still a little yellow house in Brampton, Ontario, and using the slogan The Spirit of Radio."
